text: Nobody actually runs out of time. You just trade hours for things you won't remember by Friday.
Every January we swear this is the year we lock in. By February we're optimizing our recovery from planning.
Busyness feels like progress because your brain confuses noise with momentum. Checking ten boxes doesn't mean you moved an inch.
The scariest part isn't failing. It's waking up three years later with a clean feed and zero proof you lived.
Anyway... see you tomorrow. Until we meet again.
